# Phase One — Limitless Revelation

The Awtsmoos is beyond route, class, pixel, branch, stone, leaf, creature, and world; Awtsmoos.com may still become a vessel where every visible surface is calm and every hidden depth opens only when intention asks for more.

## Product vision

- Every route is mobile-first, visually calm, futuristic, fast, and locally styled.
- Primary actions remain visible; advanced actions retract into details, drawers, sheets, inspectors, command palettes, and contextual menus.
- No route-global CSS. Shared components opt in through explicit component roots.
- No arbitrary z-index ladders. Every route owns a semantic bounded layer scale.
- Every interactive control has meaningful hover, focus-visible, active, disabled, selected/open/busy/error states.
- Motion uses transform/opacity where possible, disappears gracefully for reduced motion, and never blocks interaction.
- No fixed/sticky surface exists without explicit content clearance and safe-area handling.
- Every async UI state becomes first-class: idle, loading, empty, success, partial, error, offline, retrying, cancelled.
- Every route has a tiny boot file, focused state/domain authorities, transport adapters, views, and tests.
- Every public API is simple at the surface and data-driven underneath.
- Every touched JS file is fully documented, modular, tab-indented, readable, and free of anonymous compressed logic.

## Social network ideal

- One identity/session truth drives profile, follow graph, discovery, inbox, messages, chat, spaces, privacy, activity, and realtime.
- Follow state converges across every surface immediately and safely.
- Search cancels stale work and labels result kinds explicitly.
- Inbox events use stable typed records and derived unread state.
- Messages expose only delivery/read/presence semantics actually proven by backend evidence.
- Realtime has one transport owner, bounded reconnect, dedupe, and visible connection truth.
- Composer drafts, media, comments, replies, transformations, and retries have explicit operation state.
- Mobile Social keeps primary navigation reachable while advanced routes live in a focus-safe retractable sheet.

## Procedural core ideal

- One simple data API manifests rocks, trees, grass, flowers, creatures, materials, textures, and biome compositions.
- Seeds are deterministic and child-stream based so generation order never changes unrelated results.
- Geometry generation remains separate from Three.js manifestation where current seams permit.
- Remote textures support timeout, abort, cache ownership, fallback generation, channel maps, UV transforms, color-space hints, and disposal.
- Rocks become geology: morphology, strata, erosion, fracture, weathering, field placement, and quality tiers.
- Trees become developmental graphs: trunk/branch topology, taper, crown strategy, leaves, wind metadata, sockets, LOD.
- Grass becomes instancing-ready ecology with density fields, terrain alignment, variation, wind, and biome recipes.
- Flowers separate plant anatomy from cluster ecology.
- Creatures separate anatomy graph, proportions, skeleton, covering, sockets, movement metadata, and renderer manifestation.
- Existing public APIs remain compatible while the new surface becomes simpler.

## All pages

Home → Apps → Social → Docs → Drive → Authoring → Heichel → Profile/Auth → Messages/Media → Games → OS/Admin → Utilities/Legal → Procedural demos/docs.

Every route receives discovery, architecture, full-file rewrite only where evidence proves debt, static verification, behavior tests, browser verification where available, documentation, and a durable delta.
